scope: All 159 frozen COAD features; no selection by prior q
pairing: GEO individual; stages I-IV; exact paired normal; exclude adenoma and stage 0
primary: Author PQN normalized log min-imputed values; paired tumor minus normal; no further transformation
test: Two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank; zero_method=wilcox; method=approx; correction=False; all-zero differences P=1
effect: Median paired difference on author normalized log scale; not fold change
counts: Exact >, <, = comparisons of stored values; percent denominator all finite pairs including zero differences
multiple_testing: Separate primary and observed-only families, 159 planned each; nonestimable P=1 internally, public P/q NA
sensitivity: Both sides finite in author preimputation data sheet; minimum 8 pairs; no new imputation; counts also shown below minimum
ci: Patient-pair bootstrap percentile 95%; unadjusted descriptive interval
source_scale: Author common data_imputed, T and N sheets exact subsets; observed entries unchanged
interpretation: Tumor-normal metabolite change; not metabolite-RNA association or external validation
